name: kmj-codebridge
description: Secure, project-scoped AI coding across authorized computers and VPSs through one MCP bridge.

endpoint.title: CodeBridge MCP endpoint
endpoint.description: Your CodeBridge gateway URL ending in /mcp, for example https://bridge.example.com/mcp or http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp for a local gateway.

token.title: CodeBridge client token
token.description: The client credential from your private CodeBridge configuration (client-token.txt). Stored in your system's secure credential store.
